research_notes: Near a hard cap, the safest default when task duration is unknown is to avoid starting an unbounded unit.
A queue of small bounded maintenance/analysis units can use residual capacity without risking a large overshoot.
This is operationally preferable to artificial padding because each unit must have research or production value.
The current test follows that principle by using bounded analytical units tied to the relay design.
The future runtime contract can encode a similar fallback admission class.
Final close remains the next decisive event.
